title: The next generation: harness–model co-design
act: Act II — Where the field is
takeaway: Composition, cross-harness training, durable execution and interoperability are distinct directions, not a single product ranking.

scenes.title: Composition, not a new model
scenes.visual: 6.1.1–6.1.2: diagram of replaceable Cordis plugins; model adapter, loop, tools and session log exchange without an invented UI. 6.1.3: caption separates composability from coding evidence; no invented quotation. 6.1.4: persistent preview/safety label. dateStamp 2026-10-08 throughout chapter. 6.1.5: diagram emphasizes reversible registrations, not external undo.

sentences.text: Next-generation harnesses are developing along several axes, starting with composition rather than another model.
DeepSeek documents its MIT-licensed Harness as a Cordis runtime with replaceable loop, model adapter, tools, and session storage.
sentences.spoken: DeepSeek documents its M I T licensed Harness as a Cordis runtime with replaceable loop, model adapter, tools, and session storage.

sentences.text: The supporting composability paper is a preprint, not proof of better coding.
And this remains an unaudited developer preview, not a production-security guarantee.
Unloading a plugin reverses its runtime registrations, not necessarily an email sent or a file deleted.

onScreen.text: DeepSeek Harness · MIT · Cordis plugins: loop / model adapter / tools / session storage. Official docs accessed 2026-10-08.
Cordis: composability preprint, not coding-quality proof. Reversible runtime registrations are not a guarantee of undoing external actions.
Developer preview · not security-audited · not to be treated as secure or production-ready. As of 2026-10-08.

sentences.text: That is training for interface diversity, not demonstrated robustness to every unseen harness.
The system runs real scaffolds and tools in sandboxes, then converts their interactions into a common training format.

sentences.text: In the vendor’s fixed-checkpoint comparison, Minimal outscored Standard and programmatic tool calling on both reported coding benchmarks.
But mini-SWE led on DeepSWE, showing why the task set matters.
Separately, the independent Claw-SWE-Bench preprint placed Hermes ahead of DeepSeek Harness for all three tested models.

scenes.title: Learning, durability, interoperability
scenes.visual: 6.5.1–6.5.2: diagram separates weight training from memory/skill refinement; warning card shows exploit retained. 6.5.3–6.5.4: smallMultiples distinguishes UI detachment from crash recovery via external event histories. 6.5.5–6.5.6: protocol boundary diagram puts ACP at client/agent edge and A2A between independent apps; internal scheduling remains inside. No omp² architecture here.

sentences.text: Self-improvement can instead mean changing memories, skills, and instructions while model weights stay fixed.
Prime Agent’s technical report even describes preserving an exploit as a reusable skill.
Durable execution is another axis: surviving a worker crash requires more than keeping work alive after the interface disconnects.
Anthropic describes restarting from an external event log; Temporal describes durable waits around existing inner harnesses.
ACP links user-facing clients to agents; A2A links independent agentic applications, not their internal subagent schedules.
sentences.spoken: A C P links user-facing clients to agents; A two A links independent agentic applications, not their internal subagent schedules.

sentences.text: Composition, training, persistence, and interoperability solve different problems; none establishes a universally superior harness.

onScreen.text: Prime Agent · fixed-weight refinement of memories, supplemental instructions and executable skills; base prompt remains immutable. Exploit preservation is a reported case, not a success-rate estimate. Technical report v1 dated 2026-08-24; manuscript first published 2026-08-05.

Background lifecycle ≠ durable recovery. Prime: UI-detached work (B technical report). Anthropic Managed Agents: external event log and harness restart (C engineering article, 2026-04-08). Temporal: durable waits/event histories; earlier than public preview at its 2026-08-20 announcement (C).
Client —ACP→ agent | Independent agentic application —A2A→ independent application. Neither chooses the best internal multi-agent architecture. As of 2026-10-08.
